{{Quote|Why are you doing this?''"<br />"''A thousand years ago, this world belonged to us. You are the intruders here.|The Governor of Begeren and Teneb Kel|<ref name="BotE1" />}}
The '''Invasion of Begeren''' was a major engagement between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. [[Begeren]], a [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]]-rich [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], had historically belonged to the ancient [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], but after the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] of [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], the Republic claimed the planet as its own and installed a [[Governor/Legends|governor]] to oversee [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations. In [[3681 BBY]], the revitalized [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|emerged]] from hiding and initiated the Great Galactic War to reclaim their lost lands and destroy the Republic. Although the war swiftly spread across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the Sith's first targets lay in the Outer Rim, and in [[3678 BBY]] the Empire launched its massive invasion of Begeren in the hopes of securing the planet and ousting the entrenched Republic regime.

The [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] contingent that was landed on the world consisted of 10,000 [[Imperial soldier]]s under the command of a [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Begeren)|military officer]] and aided by the aspiring [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]], [[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]]. The fiercest [[Ground warfare/Legends|fighting]] occurred just outside the [[Unidentified Advozse Governor|Republic Governor's]] [[Begeren governor's palace|palace]] in the planetary [[Capital of Begeren|capital]], and saw the Empire's [[Aurek Battalion]] engage [[Republic soldier]]s, [[Battle droid/Legends|towering war droids]], and crippling [[Laser turret/Legends|laser turrets]]. The Imperial [[Army/Legends|Army]] forces were waiting on word from Kel that he had successfully infiltrated the palace and [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] the Governor, and although Aurek [[Battalion/Legends|Battalion]] was devastated by [[bombing run]]s from Republic [[Liberator-class starfighter|''Liberator''-class starfighters]], Kel continued on with his mission and successfully [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] Governor of Begeren. The conflict was one of many Imperial successes early in the war, and helped to put Teneb Kel on the path to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lordship]]. Begeren remained in Imperial control for many [[Time/Legends|decades]] following the conquest.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Look out from the balcony. Once, statues of great men stood before the cliffs. Those statues were monuments to warriors, alchemists&hellip; great philosophers who refined the sacred doctrines of the Sith.|Teneb Kel, on the former glory of Begeren|<ref name="BotE1" />}}
During the reign of the ancient [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], the area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] was all part of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] dominion. The [[Planet/Legends|planets]] within the [[Stygian Caldera]]&mdash;later known as the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]]&mdash;formed the core of the Empire, with the worlds of the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] at its heart.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Begeren]], a [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]]-rich terrestrial planet<ref name="BotE1" /> in the Esstran [[Sector/Legends|sector]] near Korriban,<ref name="TEA" /> belonged to the Empire and, much like the capital, was developed into a monument world meant to honor icons of Sith culture and history. On the cliffs of Begeren, Imperial masters directed their [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]<ref name="BotE1" /> of the [[Grotthu]] class<ref name="BookOfSith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> to construct massive statues of [[Sith Warrior]]s, [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemists]], and the great philosophical minds of the Sith religion. Over the course of the building projects, 100,000 slaves [[Death/Legends|lost their lives]], but the Begeren monuments stood as a testament to the Sith masters.<ref name="BotE1" />

After the [[Second battle of Korriban|end]] of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> the Sith Empire was shattered and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was victorious. At the direction of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Pultimo]],<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] undertook a [[Post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion|counterinvasion]] of the Sith Empire that subsequently engulfed the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] of the [[Stygian Caldera]] and outlying Sith colonies further afield.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="TEGtW" /> On Begeren, the Sith inhabitants were forced out by Republic occupiers who claimed the world as their own before proceeding to tear down the great monuments. The Republic installed a [[Governor/Legends|governor]] to oversee the planet and a new [[Mining/Legends|mining]] industry based around selling [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]] found within the Sith statues.<ref name="BotE1" />

Despite the Republic victory over the Empire, a group of Sith led by the mysterious [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] were able to [[Sith exodus|escape]] into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and rebuild their society.<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> In [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="TEGtW" /> this [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|revitalized Sith Empire]] [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|emerged]] from hiding and initiated the [[Great Galactic War]] to reclaim their ancestral worlds and exact revenge on the Republic that had defeated them a [[Time/Legends|millennium]] prior. After [[Battle of Korriban|retaking]] Korriban and much of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] early in the conflict,<ref name="Timeline6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref> the Empire set its sights on Begeren<ref name="BotE1" /> and prepared to invade the planet in [[3678 BBY]].<ref name="BotEDate" /> The invasion was to be led by the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] and aided by the disgraced [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] and aspiring [[Sith assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]], who had been granted a brief reprieve by the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]] from a punishment inflicted on account of transgressions committed by Kel's Master [[Calypho]].<ref name="BotE1" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Enemy using laser turrets and cacophanizer shells. Squads Three, Eight, and Fifteen are down. Seventeen can't crawl a meter without a sonic damper. Awaiting orders, sir.|An Imperial soldier reports to the Commander|<ref name="BotE1" />}}
[[File:KelBattleOfBegeren-TORWC1.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Teneb Kel witnesses the bombing of Aurek Battalion.]]
The Empire landed on Begeren with an [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|army]] consisting of 10,000 [[Imperial soldier]]s,<ref name="BotE1reprint" /> plunging the planet into violent [[Ground warfare/Legends|warfare]]. Losses were heavy for both the Imperials and the Republic during the Invasion of Begeren, but the Empire managed to march onward toward the [[Capital of Begeren|capital city]] of Begeren, where the planet's [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Unidentified Advozse Governor|Governor]] made his home. The [[Army/Legends|army's]] siege of the [[City/Legends|city]] was led by [[Aurek Battalion]], and was initially successful; however, the Empire was forced to engage in extended trench warfare outside of the Governor's [[Begeren governor's palace|palace]]. Led by an [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Begeren)|Imperial commander]], Aurek [[Battalion/Legends|Battalion]] was pinned down in the trenches by the [[Republic Army]]'s [[Republic soldier|soldiers]], massive defense droids, and heavy [[Laser turret/Legends|laser turrets]].<ref name="BotE1" />

Despite taking heavy losses, the Imperial forces remained stationary, as their [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] had agreed to hold position until he received word from Teneb Kel that he had successfully infiltrated the palace and killed the Governor. Kel did indeed manage to breach the palace's security cordon, but the Governor fled from the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] to find safety in his blast shelter. While the army waited for the signal from the young Sith, the Republic employed [[cacophanizer shell]]s to immobilize their opponents. That, combined with the [[Laser/Legends|laser]] turret barrage, resulted in the loss of Aurek Battalion's [[Squad Three (Sith Empire)|Squad Three]], [[Squad Eight (Sith Empire)|Squad Eight]], and [[Squad Fifteen]]. Although [[Squad Seventeen]] survived the assault, the cacophanizer shells made it impossible for the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] to move even a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] without using [[sonic damper]]s. Teneb Kel's slave, the [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] known as [[Qawohl|Maggot]], had accompanied his master to Begeren, but remained with Aurek Battalion to act as a warrior and as a liaison between the Imperial Commander and the Sith. The Commander, increasingly frustrated by the lack of contact from Kel, demanded that Maggot answer for his master's apparent failure. While the two argued, Republic [[Liberator-class starfighter|''Liberator''-class starfighters]] soared over the battlefield to deliver a payload of [[Bomber/Legends|bombs]]. The explosives detonated in the center of the Imperial line, decimating Aurek Battalion and killing the Commander.<ref name="BotE1" />

Having reached the uppermost floors of the Governor's palace via [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]], Teneb Kel witnessed the [[bombing run]]s, but continued with his mission regardless. He caught up with the Governor and his escort of two Republic soldiers as they raced toward the blast shelter, but the Advozse's protectors were able to push their charge into the bunker before Kel could complete his task. Angered by the Republic's decimation of Begeren's Sith heritage, Kel quickly slew the Governor's two guards through his expert use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and his [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]], [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Choke|crushing one man's windpipe]] and dispatching the second with a [[Telekinesis/Legends#Saber Throw|toss]] of his weapon. The assassin the proceeded to cut through the shelter door and execute the unarmed Governor. With his mission complete, Kel contacted [[Imperial High Command (Sith Empire)|Imperial High Command]] to inform them that the palace had been secured.<ref name="BotE1" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|My Lord, I have received word from the Citadel. The Dark Council is pleased with your results on Begeren and sends its congratulations.''"<br />"''Yet you're troubled.''"<br />"''The Council states that with the invasion complete&hellip; your reprieve is over. It's time you faced justice for the crimes of Lord Calypho.|An Imperial major congratulates, then arrests, Kel|<ref name="BotE1" />}}
[[File:Begeren_losses.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Imperial casualties on Begeren after the battle]]
With the Governor dead and the capital city fallen, Teneb Kel searched the battlefield for survivors. He came upon the body of his slave, Maggot, and discovered that the hearty Abyssin had killed many of the enemy and survived the Republic bombing, despite the fact that all of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] Imperials around him had perished. Kel helped Maggot out of the trenches and walked with his slave back to the Imperial command center. Once there, he decreed that the Imperial soldiers who participated in the battle would be permitted to celebrate their victory, provided they not attempt to profit from Begeren's natural wealth. Kel was met by an [[Unidentified Imperial major (Begeren)|Imperial major]] who had arrived to convey news from the Imperial capital of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="BotE1" />

According to the [[Major/Legends|Major]], the Dark Council was pleased with Kel's work, but demanded that the young Sith return to the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Sith Citadel]] in [[Kaas City]] to answer for the crimes of his disgraced former Master, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Calypho. On Dromund Kaas, grand celebrations were held in the city streets to recognize the recent string of Imperial successes in the war, including the victory on Begeren and [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Nankrang]]'s [[Engagement in the Mid Rim|incursion]] into the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="BotE1" /> The battle also served as a career springboard for the Imperial soldier [[Bessiker]], who continued on to serve with distinction at the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] and the long-running [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|Battle of Balmorra]].<ref name="Major Bessiker">{{TORcite|type=codex|Major Bessiker}}</ref> Begeren, now in Imperial control, was absorbed into the territory of the growing Sith dominion. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Harvus]] was placed in charge of the world, and slave pits were built to provide the Empire with a supply of laborers. Later in the Great War, an [[Begeren terrorist cell|anti-Imperial terrorist cell]] was formed in the slave population, but fell apart when the [[Lassicar|son]] of two [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] killed his [[Parent/Legends|parents]] and exposed the cell to Moff Harvus.<ref name="Lassicar">{{TORcite|type=codex|Guardsman Lassicar}}</ref> Begeren remained in Imperial control until the Sith Lord [[Tytonus]] rebelled against the Emperor and the Dark Council by [[Tytonus's revolution|seceding]] from the Empire. She declared herself [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of a new [[Tytonus's kingdom|Sith kingdom]] and took Begeren as her throne. In response, the Dark Council [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|excommunicated]] Tytonus from the Sith Order and the Empire, leaving Begeren as her isolated [[Prison/Legends|prison]], and her kingdom crumbled when she allied herself with the rogue Sith Lord [[Grathan]] and earned the Empire's wrath.<ref name="Friends of Old">{{TORcite|type=faction|Empire|Friends of Old|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Invasion of Begeren was first seen as the introductory setting of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire]]'', the second story arc in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic|''The Old Republic'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series. The battle appeared in the first pages of [[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith|''Act 1: Shades of the Sith'']], published in [[2010]] as part of a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] series.<ref name="BotE1" /> Later that year, ''Blood of the Empire'' was released as a printed series, with the Invasion of Begeren making a repeat appearance in [[The Old Republic 4|''The Old Republic 4: Blood of the Empire, Part 1'']].<ref name="BotE1reprint" /> With the release of the [[LucasArts]]/[[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[2011]], the Invasion of Begeren was given several mentions in the in-game codex, as well as historical context with regards to the Begeren terrorist cell<ref name="Lassicar" /> and Tytonus's revolution.<ref name="Friends of Old" /> The Invasion was again mentioned in several contexts in the [[2012]] sourcebook, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', which identified the battle's name.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
